messages:
Alice (Support): AcmeCorp reports a p99 spike and intermittent 504s on /v1/chat for model emberlyn when requests include very long contexts (>32k tokens). They say this started ~4h after we rolled token-v2 for emberlyn. They see tail latency climb from ~220ms to 2.4s+ and some timeouts. Attaching a small repro they provided and traces they captured.

Ben (Eng-runtime): Can you paste the exact curl + headers they used? also need a trace id and request id.

Alice (Support): Here — curl they used and the first error trace (redacted).
```\
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"emberlyn","input":"<~33k tokens payload>","timeout":30}'
```
Trace excerpt (customer): `req=01AZ9... span=svc-infer emberlyn seq=33240 p99=2.3s 504`

Maya (SRE): Is the error a gateway 504 or backend timeout? can we get the gateway request id? 504 usually means runtime didn't respond in time.

Alice (Support): They attached gateway id: gw_0b7f3a. Customer quoted both 504 and socket timeouts.

Ben (Eng-runtime): Quick hypothesis: token-v2 changed how we chunk/encode long inputs which may be causing excessive KV cache regeneration and more frequent cache invalidation, spiking CPU and stalling GPU streams. I want a repro run against staging with same tokenization and identical seq lengths.

Carla (Eng-ML): Confirming: emberlyn onboarding included a tokenizer change (token-v2) to improve Unicode handling. For long-context sequences token-v2 produces slightly different chunk boundaries which can blow up attention matrices in some legacy kernel paths. We saw small perf diffs before but not this amplitude.

Rana (Product): Impact: 2 active customers reported, P0 for SLA. Recommend immediate short mitigation (routing/fallback) while we root cause.

Maya (SRE): I'm seeing elevated kv_cache_miss_rate and kernel_queue_wait for emberlyn in the last 3 hours in prod-canary cluster. p99 CPU <-> GPU handoff time jumped. Dashboard snapshots: `kv_miss: +62%`, `kernel_wait_ms_p99: +900ms`.

Ben (Eng-runtime): Useful logs:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:21Z] infer: start req=01AZ9... seq_len=33240 tokenization=token-v2
[2026-03-17T09:12:22Z] runtime: allocate_kv_cache size=33240 status=ok
[2026-03-17T09:12:23Z] runtime: kernel_select path=SLOW_PATH reason=large_seq_boundary
[2026-03-17T09:12:24Z] runtime: enqueue_gpu task_id=4532 wait_ms=920
[2026-03-17T09:12:25Z] infer: timeout -> 504
```

Carla (Eng-ML): That kernel_select=SLOW_PATH sticks out. token-v2 may produce chunk patterns that force fallback to slower attention kernels. We need to compare token boundaries between v1 and v2 for same input. Requesting a diff tool run on the problematic input.

Alice (Support): Customer provided a minimal repro snippet. I uploaded to /shared/incidents/emberlyn-3412345678/repro.txt (internal).

Ben (Eng-runtime): Action plan from runtime side: 1) reproduce locally with same model + token-v2 and the exact sequence length, 2) run with token-v1 to compare, 3) if reproduces, push emergency mitigations: a) force tokenization fallback to v1 for emberlyn, or b) route requests with seq>30k to emberlyn-compat (old tokenizer), c) increase per-request timeout as stopgap.

Maya (SRE): I'll open a routing rule to temporarily route traffic from impacted customers to emberlyn-compat in the next 10m. Need confirmation from Product/CS to notify customers.

Rana (Product): Approve routing fallback. Customer comms: "We are investigating elevated tail latencies for long-context requests on emberlyn; we have a temporary routing/fallback in place and will follow up within 2 hours." Send from CS.

Carla (Eng-ML): Meanwhile I'll run token boundary diffs and a profiler. Early guess: token-v2 creates an extra sub-token aligning at sequence edges which increases effective sequence length for attention packing. If true, simple mitigation is to align chunking to 4k boundaries or revert token packer.

Ben (Eng-runtime): Repro steps for runtime folks (please run on a staging GPU instance):
```
# run with token-v2
python tools/repro_runner.py --model emberlyn --tokenizer token-v2 --file repro.txt --measure
# run with token-v1
python tools/repro_runner.py --model emberlyn --tokenizer token-v1 --file repro.txt --measure
# capture kernel selection logs
TAIL_LOG=logs/emberlyn_repro.log
```

Maya (SRE): I scheduled canary routing rollback and added a short-circuit: requests >30k now go to emberlyn-compat. DeployBot shows route change pending.

DeployBot: Route update created: route/emberlyn-fallback -> pending -> canary (10%). CI checks passed. Use `/deploy status route/emberlyn-fallback` for progress.

Ben (Eng-runtime): If the repro reproduces, I'll open a patch to skip the slow kernel path by forcing attention packing thresholds for emberlyn until ML provides optimized chunking. That should drop p99 quickly.

Alice (Support): CS notified AcmeCorp with the fallback and ETA 2 hours. They acknowledged. :thumbsup:

Carla (Eng-ML): Initial token-diff result: token-v2 increases avg token count by ~4% on their text and introduces a boundary pattern that trips the legacy packer. I'm running an experiment to remap boundaries at pack time.

Maya (SRE): Observability note — please add a short-term alert for kernel_queue_wait_ms_p99 > 500ms for emberlyn so we catch regressions faster.

Ben (Eng-runtime): Assigning myself to prod fix PR if repro checks out. Will also include a unit test that asserts that long-seq kernel selection doesn't regress for token-v2.

Rana (Product): Priorities: 1) customer impact mitigation (done via routing), 2) fix/regression test, 3) postmortem and guidance for future tokenizer rollouts.

Alice (Support): Next updates: Ben will post repro result in 45m, Carla will post token-diff in 30m, Maya will confirm route canary status. I'll consolidate and update the ticket.

Ben (Eng-runtime): Update — repro confirmed on staging. kernel_select still choosing SLOW_PATH for token-v2. Pushing an emergency canary patch to change attention packing threshold for emberlyn now.

DeployBot: Canary deploy of runtime-patch-emberlyn started -> health checks ok on 2/3 nodes -> promoting to 50%.

Maya (SRE): Early numbers from canary show p99 down from 2.3s to 310ms for the test payload. KV miss rate normalized.

Carla (Eng-ML): Good. I'll keep working on tokenizer packer improvements so we can re-enable token-v2 without the packing hack.

Alice (Support): Customer notified that we applied a temporary runtime mitigation and that we'll follow up with a permanent fix. They asked for postmortem. Marking as P0 -> engaged until root cause fixed.

Ben (Eng-runtime): I'll open the runtime PR and post the link. Also creating regression test in CI.

Rana (Product): Thanks team. Once PR merges and we finish validation, plan a controlled rollout for token-v2 with a preflight token-diff check for long-context customers.

Alice (Support): Closing slack loop for now — will attach postmortem link when ready.

DeployBot: Route/patch promoted to stable. Change log: runtime-patch-emberlyn #4532 applied.

Maya (SRE): Monitoring continues. If p99 climbs again we'll revert.

Carla (Eng-ML): Action items recorded: tokenizer packer fix, token-diff preflight tool, longer CI long-context tests.

Alice (Support): Thanks everyone.
